methods.description: Expand powers with the same numerical base, count the total factors and keep the base.
Expand a fraction of powers of a nonzero same base, cancel equal factors and count the remaining factors.
Expand each repeated group and count inner factors times outer groups.
Translate the observed factor counts into words and algebraic index rules with the stated domains.
Contrast same-base products/quotients with unlike bases or addition.
Use actual factors/groups to correct changed-base or wrong-index-operation claims.
Use multiplication of equal powers to explain the power-of-a-power count and compare grouping.
